svg.title: Bodman Outfits
svg.desc:
The browser-tab mark: a script capital B on the brand's everglade ground with a copper ring.
The letter is a PATH, not a text element, and that is the load-bearing decision. A favicon renders outside the page's font context, so a text element depends on a font being installed on the reader's machine and would differ per visitor. An outline renders identically everywhere and needs nothing installed - and it matters more for a script than it did for the Fraunces italic this replaces, because no system font ships a roundhand.
The glyph is capital B from Great Vibes, OFL licensed, chosen against a reference the shop supplied: a brush-drawn roundhand with a sweeping entry stroke and two bowls. Five OFL scripts were rendered against it - Allura, Pinyon Script, Parisienne and Tangerine alongside this - and Great Vibes both matched the reference closest and held together best at tab size. A mathematical script from STIX was tried first and rejected: it is upright and formal where the reference flows.
The 0.6 stroke in the shop's own off-white is deliberate and is not a border. Roundhand is a high-contrast style, so its hairlines fall below one device pixel at 16px and drop out, leaving a broken letter. The stroke reinforces them just enough to survive, and was tuned by rendering at true 16px rather than by eye at display size.
Fitted to a 46 unit box. The glyph is wider than it is tall, 1.31 to 1, so that is 46 across and about 35 down, which clears the copper ring. Coordinates at 2dp.
Drawn for 16px. Editing note: keep documentation in desc, never an XML comment - naming a CSS custom property inside a comment introduces a double hyphen, which is illegal in XML and silently renders the icon unparseable while still serving 200.
